verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a code-first workflow and background-job platform, so a prebuilt connector catalog is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, shows only plain TypeScript tasks, failure alerts via email, Slack and webhooks, and build extensions. Nothing documents a library of prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations to thousands of apps, and one community comment about it 'easily integrating with tools we use' is too vague to count.
